rules.title: Reconstruction artifacts are complete and self-declaring
rules.description: A project-baseline directory contains its required artifacts, and a reconstructed prompt declares itself reconstructed rather than presenting as an original.
rules.rationale: A reconstructed prompt that does not say so becomes indistinguishable from recorded intent, which is fabricated history.
rules.remediation: Complete the baseline artifacts, and open RECONSTRUCTED-PROMPT.md with its reconstruction disclaimer.

rules.title: Unresolved reconstruction questions stay visible
rules.description: Questions the evidence could not answer are recorded with their status and with the search that failed to answer them, and open ones are surfaced rather than quietly closed.
rules.rationale: An open question that stops being visible becomes an assumption nobody decided to make, and a question recorded without the search behind it cannot be distinguished from one nobody looked into (Standard 44 R12).
rules.remediation: Record what was inspected before the question was asked, then answer it and mark it CONFIRMED_BY_OWNER with its provenance, or leave it open deliberately.
